stops.name: Naturpark Arnsberger Wald
stops.detail: Whether you want to exhaust yourself, gather strength or satisfy your hunger for knowledge: the Arnsberg Forest Nature Park has something to offer for every demand. Immerse yourself in the Westphalian forest sea, whose fascinating light plays create a powerful atmosphere. Experience with all the senses a spectacular variety of rushing creeks, dark caves, striking rocks and habitats of animals and plants.
